description.value: The study combined fMRI measures of food-cue reward activity and response-inhibition activity with experience sampling to identify neural predictors of everyday food desires, eating enactment, and resistance to temptation.

spans.text: Here, we combined functional neuroimaging and experience sampling to determine if there are brain markers that predict whether people act upon their food desires in daily life.

description.value: An observational study of 31 female participants who completed an fMRI session followed by one week of smartphone experience sampling.
